# Maryland Sea Grant

> Maryland Sea Grant is a NOAA-affiliated research and education organization dedicated to Chesapeake Bay preservation, coastal sustainability, and marine science advancement.

Based at the University of Maryland, Maryland Sea Grant conducts research on fisheries, aquaculture, water quality, and environmental restoration while providing K-12 through graduate education programs and extension outreach across the Mid-Atlantic region.

## Key Topics

- Chesapeake Bay
- Marine Science
- Aquaculture
- Coastal Restoration
- Environmental Education
- Research Funding
- Blue Crab (Callinectes sapidus)
- Eastern Oyster (Crassostrea virginica)
- Coastal Management
- Sea Grant Program
- Extension Outreach
- Environmental Research
- Graduate Fellowships
- Science Education
- NOAA

## About & Mission

- [Maryland Sea Grant](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu): Homepage for Maryland Sea Grant, a NOAA-affiliated organization focused on Chesapeake Bay research and coastal sustainability.
- [About Maryland Sea Grant](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/about-us): Organization overview describing Maryland Sea Grant's mission for Chesapeake Bay preservation and coastal research.
- [Our Research Priorities](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/our-research-priorities): Research priorities including Chesapeake Bay ecosystems, sustainable fisheries, and resilient communities.
- [Impacts of Our Work](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/impacts-of-our-work): Program impacts and outcomes demonstrating Maryland Sea Grant's contribution to coastal resources and education.

## Research & Funding

- [Funding](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/topics/research-funding/funding): Research funding opportunities and grant announcements for Chesapeake Bay and coastal research proposals.
- [Research Projects](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/research-projects): Directory of active research projects on water quality, fish ecology, and environmental restoration in Chesapeake Bay.
- [Research Publications](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/research-publications): Published research outputs on marine science, oyster aquaculture, invasive species, and estuarine ecology.
- [For Funded Researchers](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/funded-researchers): Guidelines and requirements for Maryland Sea Grant grant and fellowship recipients including reporting and data sharing.

## Education Programs

- [Our Education Programs](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/our-education-programs): K-12, undergraduate, and graduate education programs in marine science and Chesapeake Bay research.
- [K-12 Resources](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/education/k-12-resources): Science lesson plans and project-based learning resources for K-12 classrooms on Chesapeake Bay and coastal science.
- [Undergraduate Opportunities](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/topics/undergraduate-opportunities): Internship and REU program opportunities for undergraduates in marine science, policy, and communications.
- [eSeaGrant](https://eseagrant.mdsg.umd.edu): eSeaGrant educational platform and login portal for marine resources and coastal management.

## Publications & Resources

- [Bookstore](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/Bookstore): Maryland Sea Grant publications including guides, reports, fact sheets, videos on marine science and Chesapeake Bay topics.
- [Topics A-Z](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/topics): Comprehensive topic directory covering marine science, fisheries, aquaculture, and Chesapeake Bay research areas.
- [Videos](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/topics/videos/videos): Video library featuring documentary shorts on Chesapeake Bay issues and marine science topics.

## Organization & Support

- [Our Office](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/our-office): Staff directory and contact information for Maryland Sea Grant offices at University of Maryland, College Park.
- [Employment](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/employment): Job openings and career opportunities at Maryland Sea Grant for research, extension, and education roles.
- [Help Support Maryland Sea Grant](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/donate): Donation page highlighting Maryland Sea Grant's research, education, and coastal restoration efforts since 1977.
- [Subscribe to Maryland Sea Grant News and Updates](https://www.mdsg.umd.edu/about-us/subscribe): Newsletter subscription for Maryland Sea Grant news, Chesapeake Quarterly, and publication announcements.
